title: Prospector for PyMOL: find, show and explain protein structures by name
description: Prospector for PyMOL is an open-source plugin for the molecular viewer PyMOL that lets students find, show and explain protein structures by name. A protein, gene, UniProt ID or PDB ID typed in plain words is resolved to the best experimental structure, with the ranking explained. The plugin then explains what is on screen (functional sites, bound molecules, disease variants), recolours and redraws on request, shows mutations side by side, measures and compares structures, and builds idealised models of DNA, RNA, peptides, membranes and micelles alongside real biological assemblies from the PDB. Plain-sentence requests are read by built-in rules, with an optional AI model (the user's own Anthropic API key) for the rest. Every feature is a PyMOL command and a button in a docked panel, and the PyMOL commands behind each step can be shown, so the plugin also teaches PyMOL.
